name: BoneCollection
description: Bone collection in an Armature data-block

props.name: Expanded
props.description: This bone collection is expanded in the bone collections tree view

props.name: Visible
props.description: Bones in this collection will be visible in pose/object mode

props.name: Ancestors Effectively Visible
props.description: True when all of the ancestors of this bone collection are marked as visible; always True for root bone collections

props.name: Effective Visibility
props.description: Whether this bone collection is effectively visible in the viewport. This is True when this bone collection and all of its ancestors are visible, or when it is marked as 'solo'.

props.name: Solo
props.description: Show only this bone collection, and others also marked as 'solo'

props.name: Is Local Override
props.description: This collection was added via a library override in the current blend file

props.name: Is Editable
props.description: This collection is owned by a local Armature, or was added via a library override in the current blend file

props.name: Bones
props.description: Bones assigned to this bone collection. In armature edit mode this will always return an empty list of bones, as the bone collection memberships are only synchronized when exiting edit mode.

props.name: Parent
props.description: Parent bone collection. Note that accessing this requires a scan of all the bone collections to find the parent.

props.name: Index
props.description: Index of this bone collection in the armature.collections_all array. Note that finding this index requires a scan of all the bone collections, so do access this with care.

props.name: Child Number
props.description: Index of this collection into its parent's list of children. Note that finding this index requires a scan of all the bone collections, so do access this with care.

funcs.description: DEBUG ONLY. Internal access to runtime-defined RNA data storage, intended solely for testing and debugging purposes. Do not access it in regular scripting work, and in particular, do not assume that it contains writable data

params.description: Ensure that system properties are created if they do not exist yet

returns.description: The system properties root container, or None if there are no system properties stored in this data yet, and its creation was not requested

funcs.description: Assign the given bone to this collection

params.description: Bone, PoseBone, or EditBone to assign to this collection

returns.name: Assigned
returns.description: Whether the bone was actually assigned; will be false if the bone was already member of the collection

funcs.description: Remove the given bone from this collection

params.description: Bone, PoseBone, or EditBone to remove from this collection

returns.name: Unassigned
returns.description: Whether the bone was actually removed; will be false if the bone was not a member of the collection to begin with
